b: Diamanda Galás, ML Buch Ensemble, Tim Hecker and more will play the Dutch festival next spring
Rewire has revealed the first wave of acts playing its 2027 edition.

Returning to The Hague for a 16th year next April, the festival will take in a headline set from Diamanda Galás, while ML Buch Ensemble will present the world premiere of new music at the event. Tim Hecker is also set to return to the festival to present an audiovisual show of new material with stage design from artist Vincent de Belleval, and Bendik Giske will link with visual artist and lighting designer Theresa Baumgartner for another set themed heavily around new music.
